quoted_target_consistency_scope: Narrow syntactic quoted target versus readable native target witness. Existing text/ID guards, stale-frame rules, primitive actions, semantic plan/condition parsing, completion credit, budgets and prompts unchanged. The local program rejects a contradictory answer and does not select or author a replacement. Unquoted/complex descriptions or targets without readable witnesses remain outside this check.
quoted_ocr_uncertainty_scope: Generic uncertainty allowance only for an absent ASCII alphabetic name of length4..160 one character edit from the already chosen readable witness. No exact named alternative may exist elsewhere; exact competing labels, dissimilar/short/numeric names still refuse. No target replacement, OCR rewrite, fuzzy target search or success credit; all original ID/text, fresh-frame, region, budget and task predicate guards unchanged. Counterfactual saved records only, no GUI/model calls or live acceptance.
